task.paper_title: Focused curve extraction benchmark v4.1: GC_trace 04
task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel GC_trace benchmark chart, variant 04. Scenario: calibration standards.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel gas-chromatography trace benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel chromatogram-style trace figure. No explicit panel tag is printed, so the only visible panel was anchored as the target. Legend is inside the panel at top right. Crop and plot boxes use [left, top, right, bottom] pixel coordinates with right/lower bounds treated as exclusive.

x.visible_pattern: Evenly spaced bottom-axis ticks labeled 0 to 16 in 2 min increments; fit utility classified the axis as linear-linear with a linear x fit.
x.justification: Axis-fit report selected a linear model for x with normalized RMSE 0.0003 and marked it usable for downstream.

y.visible_pattern: Evenly spaced left-axis ticks labeled 0 to 1800 in 200 a.u. increments; fit utility classified the axis as linear-linear with a linear y fit.
y.justification: Axis-fit report selected a linear model for y with normalized RMSE 0.0004 and marked it usable for downstream.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit panel label is printed in the figure; the sole visible panel was treated as the target panel.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: The four traces are visually separated throughout the main plot, so no overlap-recovery follow-up is warranted.

curves.overlap_notes: Dotted rendering causes QA under-hit warnings on some interpolated segments even though the visible trace identity remains clear.

response.interpretation_notes: Single main-panel GC-style calibration trace chart with four vertically offset chromatograms. All four traces are clearly separated; the 10 ppm dotted trace remains visually clear but QA-warned because dotted interpolation undershoots some visible gaps.
unresolved_ambiguities: The 10 ppm dotted curve remained QA-warned after one revision because the scorer under-hits some dotted-gap interpolations, although the trace itself is visually separable.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage

panels.overlap_recovery_reason: The four traces are visually separated throughout the main plot, so no overlap-recovery follow-up is warranted.
